intro: Trying to find computer science scholarships in Connecticut usually means narrowing a broad USA search down to a small set you can actually compare and apply to. This filtered slice brings together programs connected to computer and information sciences with a Connecticut location focus, so you can quickly scan what is available without wading through unrelated results. The rows below may differ in award size, deadline timing, study level, and eligibility details, and many listings in this slice often appear to have no essay requirement, though you should still verify each one. If you want a practical shortlist for the current cycle, it is worth checking these programs promptly because deadline text varies and some opportunities can close soon.
